critical_gaps: The exact Eq. (2) current-loop time constant and original PWM, initialization and Simulink EMT files were not located.
The literal Case 2 inductances cancel. The two nonzero alternatives are inferred from the reported crossover, and the larger is consistent with Fig. 3.

The Fig. 5 command time was inferred from the plotted Case 1 power rise.

anomaly_evidence.finding: Printed Lv=-0.1 H and Lg=0.1 H yield zero no-load angle-to-power slope. A nonzero residual L near 0.396 mH fits the reported Bode data.
Reproduced 6.80 degree margin and left-half-plane poles contradict the Bode-based unstable classification. The independent average model does not reproduce the growing EMT oscillation.
33 rad/s exceeds 0.1 times the 50 Hz synchronous angular frequency, 31.416 rad/s.
